ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram. In the lower left there is a label "Grass", and above it to the left there is a label "Rabbit". From the "Grass" position there is an arrow pointing to "Rabbit", with the arrowhead at "Rabbit". Reasoning: In a food web, arrows usually indicate energy or food from the organism being eaten to the organism that eats it. Therefore, the arrow points from grass to rabbit, indicating that rabbit consumes grass.
